```{r}
setwd("../data")
source('../R/nba_functions_database.R', chdir = TRUE)
year <- 2019

files <- c(
  "Bam_Adebayo_2018_2024.csv",
  "Stephen_Curry_2015_2022.csv",
  "Klay_Thompson_2015_2024.csv",
  "Draymond_Green_2015_2024.csv",
  "Kyle_Korver_2014_2020.csv",
  "James_Harden_2015_2024.csv",
  "Evan_Fournier_2015_2024.csv",
  "Anthony_Davis_2015_2025.csv",
  #"Nic_Claxton_2020_2025.csv",
  "Jarrett_Allen_2018_2024.csv",
  "Bam_Adebayo_2018_2024.csv",
  "Alex_Caruso_2018_2024.csv",
  "Kevin_Durant_2015_2024.csv",
  "LeBron_James_2015_2024.csv",
  "Joel_Embiid_2017_2022.csv"
  
)
setwd("../data")
shots_by_player <- lapply(files, function(f) {
    nba_data_csv(f, year)
})
shots_made_by_player <- lapply(shots_by_player, function(df) {
  df[df$SHOT_MADE == TRUE, ]
})
data_by_player <- lapply(files, function(f) {
  nba_data_depth(
    nba_data_csv(f, year)
  )
})
names(data_by_player) <- gsub("_\\d{4}_\\d{4}\\.csv$", "", files)
names(data_by_player) <- gsub("_", " ", names(data_by_player))
names(shots_by_player) <- gsub("_\\d{4}_\\d{4}\\.csv$", "", files)
names(shots_by_player) <- gsub("_", " ", names(data_by_player))
```

```{r}
library(spatstat.geom)
library(spatstat.explore)

df <- shots_by_player[[1]]

pp <- ppp(
  x = df$LOC_X,
  y = df$LOC_Y,
  window = owin(
    xrange = range(df$LOC_X, na.rm = TRUE),
    yrange = range(df$LOC_Y, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

lambda_hat <- spatstat.explore::density.ppp(pp, sigma = bw.diggle(pp))

plot(lambda_hat, main = "Shot intensity (Player 4)")
points(pp, pch = 16, cex = 0.3)
```

```{r}

library(spatstat.geom)
library(spatstat.explore)

# ---------------------------------------------------
# 1. GLOBAL COURT WINDOW (CRITICAL FIX)
# ---------------------------------------------------
all_x <- unlist(lapply(shots_made_by_player, function(df) df$LOC_X))
all_y <- unlist(lapply(shots_made_by_player, function(df) df$LOC_Y))

global_window <- owin(
  xrange = range(all_x, na.rm = TRUE),
  yrange = range(all_y, na.rm = TRUE)
)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 2. KERNEL DENSITY (SHOT INTENSITY PER PLAYER)
# ---------------------------------------------------
intensity_list <- lapply(shots_made_by_player, function(df) {

  df <- na.omit(df)
  df <- df[is.finite(df$LOC_X) & is.finite(df$LOC_Y), ]

  pp <- ppp(
    x = df$LOC_X,
    y = df$LOC_Y,
    window = global_window
  )

  density.ppp(pp, sigma = bw.diggle(pp))
})

names(intensity_list) <- names(shots_made_by_player)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 3. SANITY CHECK (IMPORTANT)
# ---------------------------------------------------
print(lapply(intensity_list, function(im) {
  c(min = min(im$v), max = max(im$v))
}))


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 4. VECTORIZE INTENSITY SURFACES
# ---------------------------------------------------
grid_vectors <- lapply(intensity_list, function(im) {
  as.vector(im$v)
})


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 5. DISTANCE MATRIX (L2 BETWEEN SURFACES)
# ---------------------------------------------------
n <- length(grid_vectors)
D <- matrix(0, n, n)

for (i in 1:n) {
  for (j in 1:n) {

    D[i, j] <- sqrt(sum((grid_vectors[[i]] - grid_vectors[[j]])^2, na.rm = TRUE))

  }
}

rownames(D) <- names(shots_by_player)
colnames(D) <- names(shots_by_player)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 6. RESULT
# ---------------------------------------------------
print(D)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 7. VISUALIZATION
# ---------------------------------------------------
heatmap(D, symm = TRUE)
```

```{r}

# ---------------------------------------------------
# 5. ISO-MULTIDIMENSIONAL SCALING (NON-METRIC MDS)
# ---------------------------------------------------
mds_iso <- isoMDS(D, k = 2)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 6. PLOT RESULTS
# ---------------------------------------------------
plot(mds_iso$points,
     pch = 19,
     xlab = "Dimension 1",
     ylab = "Dimension 2",
     main = "NBA Shooting Style Map (ISO-MDS)")

text(mds_iso$points,
     labels = rownames(D),
     pos = 3,
     cex = 0.4)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# 7. OUTPUT MATRIX (OPTIONAL)
# ---------------------------------------------------
print(D)
```
